// # Continuous distributions
//
// The elementary continuous families and the heavy-tailed, lifetime, and
// shaped laws built beside them: the uniform and normal forms, the
// waiting-time and power-law distributions, and the circular von Mises
// distribution. Each type is a pure parameter record; its Mean/Variance/Pdf/
// Cdf bodies live in `random.library.plato`, which also states the
// parameterization and the preconditions of each family. The gamma and beta
